notes: Creating 测试课程 (teacher 李老师, 15 periods, price 30) inserts course id 9. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
